description.en: New voter registration and EPIC (Electors Photo Identity Card) issuance for Indian citizens who have attained 18 years of age. Applications are processed through the National Voters' Service Portal (NVSP) or the Voter Helpline App.

verifiedConditions.claim: Only Indian citizens are eligible to register as voters.

The applicant must have attained the age of 18 years on the qualifying date (1st January of the year of revision of electoral roll). Citizens aged 17+ can pre-register and will be added when they turn 18.
The applicant must be an ordinary resident of the constituency where they wish to register.
The applicant must not be disqualified under any law relating to corrupt practices and other offences in connection with elections.

unverifiedEligibility: Specific rules for overseas voters (NRI) using Form 6A are not covered in this record.
Homeless persons have the right to register under their area of habitual stay; documentation requirements may differ.

requirements.claim: Form 6 (Application for inclusion of name in electoral roll) must be filled. This can be done online via NVSP/Voter Helpline App or offline at the ERO office.

Proof of age is required. Accepted documents include birth certificate, school-leaving/transfer certificate with DOB, class 10 marksheet, Aadhaar card, PAN card, driving license, Indian passport, or any other government document with DOB.

Proof of ordinary residence is required. Accepted documents include Aadhaar card, bank/post office passbook, ration card, passport, driving license, utility bills (water/electricity/gas/telephone — not older than 3 months), income tax assessment order, latest rent agreement, or post/letter delivered to current address.
Recent passport-size colour photograph is required with the application.

As per the Election Laws (Amendment) Act 2023, Aadhaar number linking with voter ID is now being facilitated. While new applicants are asked to provide Aadhaar, it is currently described as voluntary by ECI.

processInformation.claim: Registration process: (1) Fill Form 6 online via voters.eci.gov.in or Voter Helpline App, or submit offline at ERO/AERO office, (2) Upload photograph and supporting documents, (3) BLO (Booth Level Officer) may visit for physical verification, (4) Application is processed by the Electoral Registration Officer (ERO), (5) Name included in electoral roll and EPIC card issued.
doesNotEstablish: BLO verification may not happen for all applications.
Processing time depends on the revision schedule of the electoral roll.

output.claim: EPIC (Electors Photo Identity Card) is issued after successful registration. The e-EPIC (digital version) can be downloaded from the Voter Helpline App or NVSP portal.

fees.applicability: New voter registration and EPIC issuance
fees.claim: Voter registration and EPIC card issuance are completely free of charge.

processingTime.claim: Processing time depends on the electoral roll revision schedule. During continuous revision periods, applications are typically processed within 21-45 days. During special revision drives or before elections, processing may be faster.
processingTime.estimatedCompletionDatePolicy: Do not calculate a date. Processing depends on the electoral roll revision cycle and ERO workload.
processingTime.fallbackThresholdMentionedBySource: No specific fallback; applicant should check status on NVSP portal

limitations: This record covers new voter registration for Indian citizens only.
Overseas voter (NRI) registration via Form 6A is a separate workflow.
Correction, transposition, and objection workflows (Forms 7, 8, 8A) are separate.
Processing time is dependent on the electoral roll revision schedule and varies significantly.
State-specific additional requirements are not covered.
This record does not cover the separate process for service voters (armed forces, diplomatic staff).

review.reviewReason: Core registration requirements, eligibility, and process verified against ECI sources. Processing timeline is qualitative due to revision-cycle dependency.
